name: Quark Drive
description: This Paradox has a terrain or weather that optimizes it's combat abilities.
effect: When this Pokemon gains this ability, they choose a Weather or Terrain. They also pick a Base Stat. Under the chosen Weather or Terrain, they gain +2 Base Stat Increase to the chosen stat. This Ability cannot be swapped or copied (ignoring the effects of Skill Swap, Trace etc.)
